name: Secret Care Cafe
source:
In the Secret Care Cafe you are the owner of the new cafe in town. But it's not your everyday cafe shop, this place has a special care program to make it's customers really enjoy their stay.

Everyday you will have to take care of customers as well as keep good relations with your coworkers to unlock special events. Chose your own path with Cookie, Rai or Cynthia (or all 3 of them if you're lucky or none if you are not), and make sure to not get broke. Here you can find some cute scenes, while the girls interact with each other and you as well as some lewd animated scenes, both with you and (If you will let them) with clients.

Your actions and decisions will have an impact.


Random events that can trigger after day of work will make sure you will get different experience everyday. Your decisions will decide how girls will react and how they will respond to the events. Their statistics will help you keep track of that.
translation:
在秘密护理咖啡馆中，你是镇上新咖啡馆的老板。但这不是你日常的咖啡馆，这个地方有一个特殊的关怀计划，让顾客真正享受他们的逗留。

每天你都必须照顾顾客并与同事保持良好的关系来解锁特殊活动。选择你自己的道路，与Cookie、Rai或Cynthia（或者如果你幸运的话选择全部3个，如果运气不好则选择全部），并确保不要破产。在这里，你可以找到一些可爱的场景，而女孩们彼此之间和你互动，以及一些淫荡的动画场景，无论是与你还是与客户（如果你允许的话）。

你的行动和决定将会产生影响。


一天工作后可能触发的随机事件将确保你每天都会获得不同的体验。你的决定将决定女孩们将如何反应以及她们将如何应对这些事件。他们的统计数据将帮助你跟踪这一情况。
